description: Set the brands the user follows in Sightglass. companyIds replaces the whole list, so read the current one with sightglass_list_saved (kind=following) and include the ones to keep. Followed brands feed the user's home view and offer calendar.

companyIds.description: The full list of company ids to follow; it replaces the current list, so include the ones to keep.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_follow_companies
title: Follow brands
